requirements.text: Students must have the ability to color-code modules based on difficulty or interest.
Students must have the ability to hide canceled classes in their timetables.
Students must have a feature to add personal study blocks using a drag-and-drop interface.
The system must send automated alerts when new grades are posted for enrolled modules.
The system must send reminders for upcoming deadlines with customizable advance notice.
The system must allow students to choose their preferred method of receiving notifications (email, SMS, in-app).
Collect anonymous feedback regarding the quality of content in each module.
Collect feedback on the effectiveness of teaching methods and instructor accessibility.
Gather feedback on the availability and usefulness of supplementary materials.
Include a section for open-ended comments in the feedback system.
Ensure all feedback is anonymous and released to module coordinators only after grades are submitted.
The enhancements must integrate seamlessly with the existing portal authentication system.
The existing student records database schema must remain unchanged.
All features must comply with GDPR and the university's data retention policy.
